units.source_text: 不管在任何人眼里看来，信子和表兄的未来都是会结婚的。

en.t: In anyone's eyes, Nobuko and her cousin seemed destined to marry.

units.source_text: 同窗们都十分羡慕信子的未来，尤其是那些压根不认识俊吉的人对她的羡慕嫉妒之情更加强烈——这只能说是滑稽。

en.t: All her classmates greatly envied Nobuko's future, and especially those who did not know Shunkichi at all felt even stronger envy and jealousy toward her, which can only be called absurd.

units.source_text: 信子一边否认这件事，这边却又似乎尤以无意的暗示确有其事。

en.t: While Nobuko denied it, she also seemed to hint, almost unintentionally, that it was in fact true.

units.source_text: 就这样，到了毕业时刻，大家都觉得信子和俊吉是毋庸置疑是一堆准夫妻。

en.t: In this way, by the time graduation came, everyone regarded Nobuko and Shunkichi as an unquestionable couple practically engaged to be married.

units.source_text: 可是，毕业后没多久，信子却出乎同学们的意料，突然嫁给了一位毕业于高等商业学校的、马上要到大阪某商社赴任的陌生青年。

en.t: But not long after graduation, to her classmates' surprise, Nobuko suddenly married a young stranger who had graduated from a higher commercial school and was about to take up a post at a trading company in Osaka.

units.source_text: 而且，婚后没多久，信子就跟随丈夫去了大阪。

en.t: Moreover, not long after the wedding, Nobuko followed her husband to Osaka.

units.source_text: 据当时去中央车站给他们送行的人说，信子和往常一样，面露欢乐的笑容，还一直在安慰爱哭的妹妹照子。

en.t: According to those who went to Central Station to see them off at the time, Nobuko wore her usual cheerful smile and kept comforting her tearful younger sister Teruko.
